name: Instagram
tagline: Meta's visual social network for photos, Reels, Stories and DMs
facts: Not disclosed; est. ~half of Meta ads

strategy.label: Mission
strategy.text: Bring you closer to the people and things you love.

strategy.label: Vision
strategy.text: The default place to share with close friends and discover creators, from DMs to Reels.

strategy.label: Core strategy
strategy.text: AI-ranked Reels for discovery, DMs for sharing; recommendations lifted IG time spent ~6% YoY in 2025.

strategy.label: Moat
strategy.text: Social graph plus creator supply plus Meta ads stack (Advantage+) and shared infra across 3.6B daily people.

strategy.label: Key bet
strategy.text: New surfaces (iPad, Instagram for TV, Edits) and AI ranking to win time from TikTok and YouTube.

strategy.label: Your view
strategy.text: Has Instagram traded friends for strangers' Reels too far, and is DMs-first the right fix?

customers.pain: Want entertainment and private sharing without public pressure
customers.why: Reels discovery, Close Friends, Notes and DMs where their friends already are

customers.pain: Need reach, audience ownership and steady income
customers.why: Huge distribution, Edits app, subscriptions, brand-deal marketplace, cross-post to Facebook

customers.pain: Need measurable, efficient reach to buyers
customers.why: Advantage+ AI targeting, Reels and Stories ads, Shopping, click-to-message ads
Teen Accounts with PG-13 defaults, time limits, parental supervision

products.name: Feed
products.desc: Photos and carousels from follows plus recommendations

products.name: Direct (DMs)
products.desc: Messaging, Notes, reshares; primary sharing loop

products.name: Instagram Map
products.desc: Opt-in location sharing and place-based content

portfolio.north_star: Daily users who send or receive a share with friends
portfolio.key_metrics: DAU, DM sends per user, Stories posted, Close Friends usage
portfolio.guardrails: Teen safety reports, privacy complaints, notification opt-outs

products.name: Reels
products.desc: Short-form vertical video ranked by AI

products.name: Instagram for TV
products.desc: Reels channels on TV; launched Dec 2025

portfolio.north_star: Time spent on satisfying video sessions per daily user
portfolio.key_metrics: Reels watch time, reshares, original content share, session length
portfolio.guardrails: Regretted time, unoriginal or AI-slop share, creator churn

products.name: Edits
products.desc: Standalone video editing app for creators

products.name: Subscriptions
products.desc: Paid fan subscriptions for exclusive content

products.name: Creator Marketplace
products.desc: Brand-creator deal matching and partnership ads

portfolio.north_star: Advertiser conversions per ad dollar spent
portfolio.key_metrics: Ad impressions, price per ad, ROAS, creator earnings
portfolio.guardrails: Ad load per session, user sentiment, policy violations in ads

rows.who_uses: All users scrolling feed and Stories

rows.how: Interstitial video ads in Reels feed, auction priced
Ads open DM or WhatsApp chat, pay per result
Subscriptions with Meta/app-store cut; boosted creator content

bullets.label: Revenue mix
bullets.text: Almost entirely advertising; Meta FoA ad revenue $59.4B in Q2'26 (+27%), Instagram est. roughly half.

bullets.label: Users vs payers
bullets.text: ~3B users pay nothing; millions of advertisers pay, with SMBs the long tail.

bullets.label: Unit economics
bullets.text: Q2'26 Meta ad impressions +14%, price per ad +12%; AI ranking lifts both time and conversions.

bullets.label: Growth levers
bullets.text: Reels ad load, DMs/business messaging, India and emerging-market ARPU, new surfaces like TV.

bullets.label: Cost side
bullets.text: Shares Meta's 2026 capex of $115-135B for AI infra and ranking models.

friction: Feed full of strangers' Reels, fewer friends' posts
Ad load and sponsored posts feel heavier every year
Creators complain reach is unpredictable after algorithm changes
Teen safety and mental-health concerns drive regulatory pressure
Unoriginal reposts and AI slop crowd out originals

competitors.label: Creators
competitors.text: YouTube, TikTok, Substack, Patreon for monetisation

competitors.label: India
competitors.text: YouTube Shorts, Moj, Josh, ShareChat after TikTok ban

competitors.label: Edge
competitors.text: Social graph plus Meta AI ranking and ads machine at 3B scale

competitors.label: Risk
competitors.text: Teen-safety laws and lawsuits, EU DMA, TikTok winning Gen Z attention
